Configuration

Runner settings

Compiled languages run through a Judge0-compatible API. The public default can be rate-limited or temporarily unavailable. Use a trusted endpoint you control or have permission to use. The base URL is stored in this browser only.

Example format: https://your-judge0-host.example. Do not include /submissions at the end. Runs may send your source code and stdin to the configured host.

What works where
JavaScript

Local worker, with a short timeout. DOM access is not available.

HTML / CSS

Rendered in a sandboxed iframe preview.

Other compiler languages

Sent to Judge0-compatible service; network required.

Editor and notes

Autosaved in localStorage on this browser/device.
